# 0.0.0-dev.2: ???? (??-??-????)

## Breaking changes

- details now requires Quarto 1.10 or later.

## Features

- `details` provides a markdown-like syntax for creating expandable/collapsible details sections in Quarto documents.

## Bug fixes

- Custom IDs, as in `{#install .details}`, now carry over to Typst, PDF and
  Word output, so links to them work. Previously, a link to a details block
  broke Typst compilation.
- Summaries taken from a heading or a `.summary` div now render math and
  resolve cross-references such as `@fig-plot`, both in HTML and in the
  callout titles of Typst, PDF and Word output. Those callout titles also keep
  bold and code formatting.
- `show-controls: true` no longer adds an empty slide to the start of RevealJS
  presentations.
- A heading becomes the summary only when it is the first block in the
  details div. Previously, the first heading anywhere in the div was moved
  into the summary.
- Classes and attributes on a details div, such as `.my-class` or `style`, now
  carry over to the `<details>` element.
- The `show-controls` buttons now expand and collapse only details blocks,
  leaving Quarto's code-fold blocks alone.
- `accordion-mode="synchronized"` now works for `group` names that contain
  quotes or backslashes.
- The attributes on `<details>` now come out in the same order on every render.

## Documentation

- The README and home page now show how to enable the filter with
  `filters: [details]`.
- The configuration examples now use `summary-text`, the key the extension
  reads, instead of `summary` and `non-interactive-summary`.
- The debug page now notes that `debug: true` messages appear only with
  `quarto render --verbose`.
